name: Secure identity
description: The adversary leverages an arrange of techniques and services to secure his (online) identities.

subtechniques.name: Alias
subtechniques.description: The adversary operates under one or more aliases to hide his true identity.

subtechniques.name: Anonymous Google account

subtechniques.name: Avoid DNA tests
subtechniques.description: DNA might be sold and is readily available for law enforcement agencies which could de-anonymize someone who left DNA somewhere.

subtechniques.name: Avoid reuse
subtechniques.description: Reusing usernames, passwords, email addresses, and so on is a bad practice. They could be used to trace activities back to you and de-anonymize you.

subtechniques.name: Avoid services which require phone number
subtechniques.description: Personal registered phone numbers could be used to de-anonymize you. Avoiding services which require phone numbers mitigates this risk.

subtechniques.name: Avoid signing messages
subtechniques.description: Not PGP signing messages on forums or marketplaces provides you the ability for plausible deniability, because you can claim that someone else accessed your account. Which is harder to claim when your private key was used to sign a message.

subtechniques.name: Avoid TOR over VPN
subtechniques.description: Tor over VPN introduces a permanent entry guard, which could be used to de-anonymize you.

subtechniques.name: Avoid trusting someone
subtechniques.description: Never trust anyone to prevent them from abusing your trust.

subtechniques.name: Behave differently for each anonymous identity
subtechniques.description: The way you type (speed/accuracy), the words you use (careful with usual expressions), the response you use (if sarcastic by default. Try to have different approach with identities), the way you use your mouse and click (try solve captcha’s differently). Avoid habits, change behavior to travel to content,

subtechniques.name: Burner laptop
subtechniques.description: A burner laptop might be used which is not tied to one’s identity.

subtechniques.name: Buy at places usually not visited
subtechniques.description: To make it less likely to run into someone you know or someone will recognize you, visit places you usually don’t visit.

subtechniques.name: Change Tor node between each session
subtechniques.description:
To make correlation attacks harder, Tor exit nodes should be changed between every session in which transactions are made.

subtechniques.name: Clean keyboard
subtechniques.description: To prevent leaving fingerprints the keyboard should be cleaned.

subtechniques.name: Clean phone camera
subtechniques.description: To prevent leaving fingerprints in photo’s, the camera might be cleaned before using it.

subtechniques.name: Close all activities first before using anonymous identity
subtechniques.description: To prevent cross-contamination, all activities must be segmented. This also means that all non-anonymous activities must be closed before going anonymous.

subtechniques.name: Compartmentalize graphics drivers
subtechniques.description: Using the same GPU for virtual machines results into the WebGL fingerprint. Each VM should therefore have different graphic drivers to prevent the same fingerprint.

subtechniques.name: Computer Name spoofing
subtechniques.description: Spoofing MAC addresses is insufficient because the computer name and host name could still link the MAC addresses back to both. Therefore both computer and host names might be changed every time before and after they connect to any network.

subtechniques.name: Create fake identity legend
subtechniques.description:
Create fake identity What is a legend? Well, it is a full back-story for your character:
•Age
•Sex
•Gender
•Ethnicity
•Place of Birth and date of Birth
•Place of residence
•Country of origin
•Visited Countries (for travels for instance)
•Interests and hobbies
•Education History
•Work experience
•Health information
•Religion if any
•Goals
•Family history
•Family composition if any (Children? Spouse? Husband?)
•Relationship Status if any (Married? Single?)
•Spoken Languages
•Personality traits (Introvert, Extrovert …)
All these should be crafted carefully for every single identity, and you should be incredibly careful to stick to the details of each legend when using those identities. Nothing can leak that could lead to your real persona. Nothing could leak that could compromise the consistency of your legend. Everything should always be consistent.

subtechniques.name: Pseudonym
subtechniques.description: A pseudonym or alias is a fictitious name that a person assumes for a particular purpose, which differs from their original or true meaning. This also differs from a new name that entirely or legally replaces an individual's own. Many pseudonym holders use them because they wish to remain anonymous and maintain privacy, though this may be difficult to achieve as a result of legal issues.

subtechniques.name: Purchase at remote location
subtechniques.description: To reduce the likelihood to be recognized, purchases at random remote locations should be preferred.

subtechniques.name: Random profile picture
subtechniques.description: Random profile pictures might be used to prevent any information which relates to one’s identity.

subtechniques.name: Random usernames
subtechniques.description: Random usernames which are not tied to identities in any way might be used.

subtechniques.name: Remove personal information
subtechniques.description: Deleting one’s digital footprint reduces the information that can be found by others. Which in return could be used to de-anonymize someone.

subtechniques.name: Short lifetime anonymous identities
subtechniques.description: Anonymous identities are difficult to maintain over long periods of time, therefore they should be short-term and short-lived identities which are rotated regularly.

subtechniques.name: Sock Puppets
subtechniques.description: Sock puppets are fake accounts used for example to conduct investigations.

subtechniques.name: Test burner phone at random location
subtechniques.description: Burner phones might be tested at random remote locations, to prevent them to be traced back to you, for example your house or local area.

subtechniques.name: Use language associated with fake identity's country
subtechniques.description: Adapt your language/writing to the identity to not raise suspicions and lower your chances of being fingerprinted by online platforms. Be especially careful with using pedantic words and figures of speech/quotes that could allow some people to guess your writing is very similar to that person with this Twitter handle or this Reddit user.
